title: A Theory of Cross-Validation Variance
abstract: arXiv:2611.14463v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-validation estimates predictive performance by repeatedly splitting the data into training and validation sets, fitting the model on the first and evaluating it on the second. Every observation influences the estimate in two roles, through its own evaluation when it is held out and through the models it helps fit when it trains. The random splits determine its weight in each role. From this representation, we prove an exact finite-sample identity for the variance of the cross-validated estimate. For a given splitting scheme with a common training set size, the variance is a function of these weights, with constants of the model, the metric, and the population. It covers metrics averaged over observations, such as mean squared error, and over case--control pairs, such as the AUC. The identity shows which schemes to use. translated_abstract: 交叉验证通过反复将数据划分为训练集和验证集来估计预测性能，在训练集上拟合模型并在验证集上进行评估。每个观测值以两种角色影响估计结果：当它被留出时通过其自身的评估产生影响，当它作为训练数据时通过其帮助拟合的模型产生影响。随机划分决定了它在每种角色中的权重。基于这一表示，我们证明了交叉验证估计方差的精确有限样本恒等式。对于具有相同训练集大小的给定划分方案，方差是这些权重的函数，并附带取决于模型、度量和总体的常数。该理论涵盖了在观测值上取平均的度量（如均方误差），以及在病例-对照对上取平均的度量（如AUC）。该恒等式指明了应采用哪些划分方案。方差可分解为仅取决于训练集大小的抽样方差，以及由（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文证明了交叉验证估计方差的精确有限样本恒等式，将方差表示为每个观测值在训练与评估两种角色中权重的函数，从而为应选择何种数据划分方案提供了理论指导。
en_tdlr: This paper proves an exact finite-sample identity for the variance of cross-validated estimates, expressing it as a function of each observation's weights in its training and evaluation roles, thereby providing theoretical guidance on which data-splitting schemes to use.
